Handoff · login-google-v1.html

Sign in with Google

Everything needed to build the truex login page: one Google button that both signs in and signs up, a full-name step, and the workspace hand-off. The right pane reuses the capabilities board from the join-invite page and shows no tenant data. Values are copied from the prototype. Anything marked proposal is not in the prototype and needs a product or backend decision.

Prototype: design/login-google-v1.htmlCompanion: join-tenant-v3-dev-spec.htmlTarget: app.tsx + index.htmlOct 12, 2026

Overview

A split-screen login page. The left pane is the only interactive part: the user signs in or signs up with Google, confirms their full name, and lands in a workspace. The right pane is a static marketing board that explains what truex does.

Goals

  • One entry point for sign in and sign up. The backend decides which one happened.
  • Collect a full name with almost no typing: prefill it from Google, let the user correct it.
  • Reveal nothing about tenants before authentication. No workspace names, member counts or people on the pre-auth page.

Out of scope

  • Email-link and password sign-in (removed from this design).
  • Usernames or @handles (removed; full name only).
  • SAML/SSO. The page only links to it ("SSO team? Use SAML").
  • Workspace creation and join-request screens after the hand-off.

Prototype-only controls

Do not ship these: the Preview state segmented control at the bottom of the left pane (Returning user / New user / Popup closed), the hard-coded sample accounts, and the timed fake loading phases. The Auto / Light / Dark theme control in the header is real and maps to useTheme() with localStorage["truex-theme"], same as the join page.

Prototype vs production

Read this first. The prototype draws Google's account chooser and consent screen inside our card so the full flow can be reviewed. In production we cannot render a user's Google accounts. Google renders steps 1 and 2 in its own popup (or a full-page redirect), and we only learn the result.
StepPrototypeProduction
1 AccountInline .gpanel with account rowsGoogle popup. Our card shows the waiting state (below) while it is open.
2 AccessInline consent list + "Allow and continue"Google popup. For openid email profile Google usually shows a short "Sign in to truex" notice, not a full consent list.
3 Your nameOur UIOur UI, unchanged.
4 WorkspaceOur UI with sample dataOur UI with data from the auth response.

Production waiting state (proposal)

Shown from the Google button click until the popup returns. Steps 1 and 2 are both is-on conceptually, so mark step 1 as busy and keep step 2 pending.

  • Progress: step 1 is-on is-busy (spinning ring), bar at 0.
  • Card body: the Google button becomes disabled with a spinner and the label "Finish in the Google window".
  • Below it, a text button "Didn't see a window? Open it again" that re-triggers the popup (popup blockers).
  • On success, jump straight to step 3 (or step 4 if the name step is skipped, see open questions).

Keep the inline consent panel's content as reference for what we request. It is the copy for the privacy note under the Google button and for the help centre.

Flow and steps

Start ──Google button──▶ [Google popup: account → access] ──ok──▶ Your name ──submit──▶ Workspace
  ▲                              │                                    │
  └────── closed / denied ◀──────┘                                    └─ back arrow: none (name is ours, no back)

Progress checkup

Same component as the join page (.check-h, .bar, ol.steps), but four steps instead of three.

#LabelDone when
1AccountGoogle returns an account
2AccessGoogle grant succeeds and the backend verifies the token
3Your nameName saved
4WorkspaceWorkspace resolved (open, request to join, or create)
  • Grid: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)), two columns under 420px.
  • Counter text: "{n} of 4". role="progressbar", aria-valuemax="4".
  • Step classes: is-on (current), is-busy (spinning ring, no number), is-done (filled, ✓), is-bad (error, "!").
  • Bar width: n / 4 × 100%; on error .bar.bad with a 25% red stub.

Full name step

Prefill

  1. ID token name claim.
  2. Else given_name + " " + family_name.
  3. Else empty, with hint "shown to teammates".

The input is focused and its text selected on entry, so typing replaces it and Enter accepts it.

Rules as coded

clean(s)  = s.trim().replace(/\s+/g, " ")
isName(n) = n.length >= 2 && /\p{L}/u.test(n)   // at least one letter, any script
maxlength = 60
initials(n) = first letter of the first two words, uppercased
EventResult
Enter stephint "from Google", avatar shows initials of the prefill
Input, validhint "looks good" in --success-text, avatar updates, error cleared
Input, invalidhint "shown to teammates", avatar "?" with dashed ring
Submit invalid (button or Enter)aria-invalid="true", red border, error "Add your full name so teammates know who you are.", focus stays in the field
Submit validsave clean(name); input readonly while saving

Server must apply the same rules and also strip control characters and reject strings that are only punctuation or emoji. Do not reject non-Latin names.

Build it from join-tenant-v3-dev-spec.html § Board geometry → Legend: same markup, materials, specimens, motion and parallax. Make it one shared component used by both pages with a variant prop for copy.

No tenant data on this page. The login page is public and pre-auth. The board is static: it never reads the user, the workspace or the invite, and it does not change when the user signs in.

Google OAuth

Recommended setup

  • Library: Google Identity Services, authorization code flow, ux_mode: "popup". Fall back to ux_mode: "redirect" on mobile Safari and when the popup is blocked.
  • Scopes: openid email profile only. Drive, Gmail and Calendar are requested later, per integration, with incremental auth.
  • Params: prompt=select_account (always show the chooser so people can switch between work and personal), state (CSRF), PKCE code_challenge (S256), nonce.
  • Exchange: the backend swaps the code for tokens. The browser never sees the refresh token.

Token checks (backend)

  • Verify the ID token signature against Google's JWKS.
  • iss is https://accounts.google.com or accounts.google.com; aud is our client ID; exp not passed; nonce matches.
  • Require email_verified === true before any account linking or workspace matching.
  • Identify users by sub, not email. Email can change.

API (proposal)

POST /api/auth/google
  body: { code, codeVerifier, state }
  200:  {
    user: { id, email, name, picture, isNew: boolean, needsName: boolean },
    workspace: null
      | { id, name, logoUrl, membership: "member" | "eligible" , lastActiveAt?, runningAgents?, memberCount? }
  }
  sets: session cookie (HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax)
  4xx:  { error: "invalid_grant" | "email_unverified" | "account_disabled" | "domain_blocked" }

PATCH /api/me
  body: { name }
  200:  { user }
  422:  { error: "invalid_name" }

POST /api/workspaces/{id}/join-requests     // "Request to join" (new user, domain match)

workspace is only returned after authentication, and only for membership: "member" or a verified-domain match. needsName is true when the user has no saved name yet.

Error mapping

SourceCodeUI
GISpopup_closedError state: "Google sign-in closed before it finished. Nothing was shared. Try again when you're ready."
GISpopup_failed_to_openWarn banner: "Your browser blocked the Google window. Allow pop-ups or try again." Retry uses redirect mode.
Googleaccess_deniedSame as popup closed.
Backendemail_unverifiedBad banner: "Verify your email with Google first, then try again."
Backendaccount_disabledBad banner: "This account is turned off. Contact your workspace admin."
Backenddomain_blockedWarn banner: "{domain} signs in with SSO." + "Use SAML" button.
Backendinvalid_grant / 5xx / networkBad banner: "We couldn't finish signing you in. Try again." Keep the Google button enabled.
Name saveinvalid_nameInline name error (same copy as client validation).

All errors put step 1 (or the failing step) in is-bad, turn the bar red and return focus to the Google button or the field at fault. New copy above is proposal.

Security and privacy

  • Pre-auth page leaks nothing. No tenant, member, agent or invite data in HTML, JS bundles, API calls or the board.
  • No account enumeration. Sign-in and sign-up are the same request. Do not show "no account for this email" before Google verifies it.
  • Domain matching only for verified email. For Google Workspace accounts prefer the hd claim. Treat consumer domains (gmail.com, outlook.com, …) as no match.
  • Session: HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax cookie; rotate the session ID after login.
  • Rate limit POST /api/auth/google per IP and per sub.
  • Name is display data only. Never use it for authorization. Escape it everywhere it renders (the prototype uses textContent and an escapeHTML helper for banners).
  • Profile picture: proxy or re-host it; do not hotlink Google's URL into pages other users see.

Accessibility

In the prototype

  • Polite live region #live announces each state change and loading phase.
  • Progress bar has role="progressbar" with value, min and max.
  • Name input has a visible label, aria-describedby to its error and aria-invalid on failure.
  • Back buttons are real buttons with aria-label. Board is aria-hidden; the legend is the readable version.
  • prefers-reduced-motion stops the board's float, aurora and sweep animations.

To do in production

  • Move focus to the step heading ("What should we call you?") when the name step opens, then to the input. The prototype focuses the input only.
  • Return focus to the Google button after an error.
  • The busy button must stay focusable or move focus to the live text; don't strand keyboard users on a disabled element.
  • Check contrast of --ink-3 hint text (12px) on --surface in both themes; the join spec flags it as borderline.

Full WCAG conformance still needs manual testing with assistive technology.

Build plan

  1. Board component. Extract the join page board into <CapabilitiesBoard variant="join" | "login">. The login variant takes no user or workspace props.
  2. Shared left-pane pieces. Reuse ProgressCheckup (make step count a prop), Banner, NameField, PrimaryButton from the join page.
  3. New pieces. GoogleButton, SignedInSummary (me-row + workspace card).
  4. State machine. start → waiting → verifying → name → saving → done, with error reachable from waiting, verifying and saving. Skip name when needsName is false (pending decision).
  5. Compact layout. .is-compact on every state except start and error.
  6. Backend. /api/auth/google, PATCH /api/me, domain matching, join requests.
  7. Route. /login; /signup renders the same page with the sign-up entry copy. Preserve a ?next= return URL (validate it is same-origin).

QA and acceptance

Visual

  • Matches the screenshots above in light and dark at 1440×800.
  • No scroll in the left column at 1440×768 and taller, on every step.
  • Board renders identically to the join page except the copy listed in Capabilities board.
  • Stacked layout at 390px: card first, board second, legend one column.

Behaviour

  • New Google account → name step prefilled → "Create my account" → workspace or "Create a workspace".
  • Existing account → "Welcome back" → "Open {workspace}".
  • Closing the Google popup shows the error state and nothing is created server-side.
  • Blocked popup falls back to redirect and still completes.
  • Name " Ana María López " saves as "Ana María López". "A", " " and "123" are rejected. "李雷" is accepted.
  • Enter in the name field submits. Double-clicking the button sends one request.
  • Personal Gmail never matches a workspace; unverified email never matches.
  • View source and network tab on /login show no tenant data before sign-in.
  • Theme choice persists in localStorage["truex-theme"] and is shared with the join page.

Test matrix

Chrome, Safari, Firefox, Edge (latest), iOS Safari, Android Chrome. Popup blockers on and off. Third-party cookies blocked.

Open questions

  1. Name step for returning users. The prototype shows it to everyone. Recommendation: show it only when needsName is true, and let returning users change their name in settings.
  2. Workspace matching. Auto-join, request to join, or only show the match? The prototype uses "Request to join".
  3. Several workspaces. The prototype shows one card. Need a picker if a user belongs to more than one.
  4. Profile picture. Store Google's photo now, or only initials until the user uploads one?
  5. Other providers. Microsoft or GitHub sign-in later? If yes, keep the button area a list.
